Welcome! I am a visiting professor in quantitative methods at the Department of Social Sciences at the University Carlos III of Madrid. Previously, I was a postdoctoral researcher at Witten/Herdecke University and a PhD candidate at Aarhus University.
My research interests include representation, electoral systems, party politics, and political violence. Methodologically, I am interested in causal inference and quantitative text analysis. 
You can contact me at eaviganoac@gmail.com. My CV can be downloaded here.
